children: On September 10, 2026, Nasdaq notified the company that its securities are subject to delisting from the Nasdaq Global Market after it failed to regain compliance with the $1.00 minimum bid price requirement by September 9, 2026. The company will request a hearing, which will stay any suspension or delisting, and it expects its stock to continue trading pending the process. On August 24, 2026, it also filed a proxy to seek approval for a 1-for-5 to 1-for-15 reverse split to regain compliance.
